title: HTTP/3 download is almost 5x times slower than HTTP/2

### I did this

I do have working Nginx server for testing HTTP/3 and QUIC

Nginx build info:


### I expected the following

Download speed over HTTP/3 faster than over HTTP/2, but it's 5x times slower. I did the same file download using Chrome over HTTP/3 and download speed is about 148129 kbps which is about the same as HTTP/2 test with curl above.
